noncomputable section
namespace PiExponent.FormalJetDerivatives
open MvPowerSeries
open PiExponent.JetGeometry

variable {σ R : Type*} [CommRing R]

theorem pderiv_mem_rationalWeightedIdeal (v : σ → ℚ) (hv : ∀ i, 0 ≤ v i)
    (H : ℚ) (f : MvPowerSeries σ R)
    (hf : f ∈ rationalWeightedIdeal v hv H) (i : σ) :
    pderiv R i f ∈ rationalWeightedIdeal v hv (H - v i) := by
  intro d hd
  rw [coeff_pderiv, hf, zero_mul]
  rw [map_add, Finsupp.weight_single, one_nsmul]
  linarith



def jetFrame (m : ℕ) (i : Fin (m + 1)) :
    Derivation R (MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) R) (MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) R) :=
  if i = 0 then (1 + X (0 : Fin (m + 1)) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m+1)) R) • pderiv R 0 else pderiv R i







def jetFrameWord (m : ℕ) (word : List (Fin (m + 1)))
    (f : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) R) : MvPowerSeries (Fin (m + 1)) R :=
  word.foldr (fun i g => jetFrame m i g) f



end PiExponent.FormalJetDerivatives

end

end OAI
natural_language_statement: For m ≥ 0, jetFrame m i is a derivation on multivariate power series in m + 1 variables: at index 0 it is (1 + X₀) times the zeroth partial derivative, and at every nonzero index it is the corresponding partial derivative. jetFrameWord applies a list of these derivations by right fold. For nonnegative rational weights v, if a series belongs to rationalWeightedIdeal v hv H, then its i-th partial derivative belongs to rationalWeightedIdeal v hv (H − v i).
